in_marathi.name: Adhvik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adhvik is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘adh’ meaning towards and ‘vik’ meaning knowledge. This name signifies moving towards knowledge or wisdom. It is also considered a name for the fearless and intelligent.
